label: 블러드 녹턴 3D
note: 3D app update. New screens in the kit's style: the chronicle is an open book of two pages - that night 1697 on the left, tonight 1797 on the right - where a deed and what became of it stand on one row, joined across the fold; the bag shows what the hero carries (things of the story, things that are used up, the silver); what he takes and what the chronicle writes come up as cards beside the game, and a book chip stays until the book is opened; a choice (the silver or the iron key, stone or wood) is two large cards confirmed by a second tap; Rook sells for the silver from jars: a draught that is used by itself when the hero would fall (two at most), bell oil and a guide candle. After the ending card the chronicle opens once. The whip: the lash now touches the enemy on the very tick the hit lands, together with the freeze, the flash and the sound; the streak no longer kinks, the lash leaves the hand without a gap, and a hit on an enemy beside the hero swings over instead of jumping there. A bell that will not answer is felt without reading: a grey ring, the hero thrown back, one dull toll and one heavy vibration, free again after half a second. A skill or hook pressed during a roll, a stun or in the air fires the moment the hero is free, and a queued combo hit is no longer wiped by a stray skill press (a jump or a roll still takes its place). Many enemies or jars struck in one tick sound like many, and the finishing blow sounds on its tick at full level. Fixed: the back key during a bell crossing no longer leaves the game; the place name no longer shows through the pause panel; the pause button is taken off during a crossing. Saves written by the previous three builds load and continue. Known: jars stand again when an area is entered again, so silver can be gathered without end (what can be bought is capped); the spark of a hit is drawn one frame after the contact; the hook under the graveyard ring during a fight answers about 84 presses of 100; the ending's closing banner is not seen for its time. The 2D app is unchanged (462996).
